fusions.name: Sprung Latch
fusions.desc: Kicks an enemy and deals 5 blunt damage, leaving it 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Gate
fusions.desc: Drops a ring of bars around you that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, ignoring armour, and leaves them [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your movement speed then rises by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fence Behind
fusions.desc: Drops a row of bars 5 tiles long for 6 seconds that nothing crosses, and your movement speed rises by 25% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of Reach
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
